expectations.says: The anaesthetic table holds both anaesthetics, and both belong to the same hospital visit.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics, COUNT(DISTINCT a.visit_occurrence_id) AS visits FROM omop.anaesthetic a JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE vd.visit_detail_source_value IN ('990000331', '990000332')

expectations.says: Two systolic readings point at the first anaesthetic and one at the second, each at the anaesthetic during which it was taken.
expectations.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000331' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_anaesthetic, SUM(CASE WHEN vd.visit_detail_source_value = '990000332' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS second_anaesthetic FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.visit_detail vd ON vd.visit_detail_id = a.visit_detail_id WHERE m.measurement_concept_id = 3004249 AND m.measurement_datetime BETWEEN a.start_datetime AND a.end_datetime AND vd.visit_detail_source_value IN ('990000331', '990000332')

expectations.says: No reading of the child points at an anaesthetic outside whose times it was taken.
expectations.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS readings FROM omop.measurement m JOIN omop.anaesthetic a ON a.anaesthetic_id = m.measurement_event_id JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = m.person_id WHERE p.person_source_value = '990000311' AND m.measurement_datetime NOT BETWEEN a.start_datetime AND a.end_datetime
